As a rape survivor, I wish that people wouldn’t gloat over the idea of the trumps getting raped in prison. 
We need to get entirely away from the idea that sexual assault is a punishment. 
#MeToo

@sarynthumps @lalasoo Oh, and I found him on here, and he was tweeting a lot about #MeToo I couldn’t help but reply with vague “Really, Jay?”s. He blocked me and started emailing my friends about how I seemed to be confused and he wanted to help 🤢 You know, him being an international yogi and all.

@MikeMjknapp @SailorHaumea @fawfulfan This was my issue with #MeToo . Aside from shaming a few millionaires, we didn’t accomplish much. We could have demanded that all rape kits are tested, and that statutory limits are abolished. Many people have no idea how less than 4% of rapists spend even one night in jail.
